subject: Acme Payments MAP — rapid onboarding: SOC 2 / SIG / DPA / retention checklist
messages:
From: Emma Liu <emma.liu@acme-payments.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@acme-payments.com
Date: 2027-09-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP kickoff — security gate expectations and timeline

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — Acme is excited about Redwood's latency profile for our risk models. Before we proceed to a trial, security wants a compact MAP that lays out the evaluation gates and an accelerated close timeline. High-level asks from our side:

- SOC 2: we need your latest Type II report and an artifact mapping (which controls map to which evidence files).
- SIG/CAIQ: a completed CAIQ plus any known gaps; we can accept a plan for addressing low/med items within the PoC window.
- DPA: legal will want a short DPA we can sign; we have a few data residency/retention redlines.
- Data retention: confirm default retention windows for logs, embeddings, and customer content; we may require a shorter residency window for EU data.

Can you send a draft MAP with milestone dates and clear owners (security, legal, engineering) that fits a 3-week evaluation + 2-week legal close if possible? We can be flexible on the PoC scope but need the gating items explicit.

Also attaching a one-pager with our high-level security questions.

Thanks,
Emma Liu
Head of Security Operations
Acme Payments
[attachment: acme_security_questions.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Ben Torres <ben.torres@acme-payments.com>
Date: 2027-09-02T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — security gate expectations and timeline

Emma — thanks for the clear list. Draft MAP attached (Acme_MAP_v1.xlsx) and below is a compressed plan that aims for your requested 5-week runway (3w PoC + 2w legal). Let me know where you want to pull the timeline in/out.

Executive summary (proposed):
- Week 0 (today): MAP shared, kickoff + access provisioning checklist. Owners: Kimberly (Redwood AE), Jordan (Solution Eng) for infra access.
- Week 1: Evidence intake — SOC 2 Type II + CAIQ baseline review. Owner: Neha (Compliance). Redlines captured in shared drive.
- Week 2: PoC run (integration + sample traffic), SIG/CAIQ gap remediation plan drafted for medium items. Owner: Jordan.
- Week 3: Evidence handoff & acceptance criteria review. Security verifies SOC 2 artifacts and key control tests.
- Week 4: Legal DPA review (we'll produce a DPA with your redlines pre-marked). Owner: Legal / Kimberly to coordinate.
- Week 5: DocuSign + final signoff.

Key gating details (short):
- SOC 2: we will provide our latest Type II report + evidence map (.pdf) and a short walkthrough session. If you need on-site evidence, flag it now.
- SIG/CAIQ: full CAIQ export attached; low priority items we can accept as backlog tasks to be completed within 60 days post-sign. Medium items that impact encryption or data isolation we will aim to patch or provide compensating controls within PoC.
- DPA & retention: default retention windows: logs = 90 days, embeddings = 30 days, customer content = per-customer TTL (default 365 days). For EU-residency we can enable region pins for data-at-rest and reduce logs retention to 30 days — legal will note this as an optional addendum.

Attachments included: Acme_MAP_v1.xlsx (timeline + owners), SOC2-evidence-request.pdf (template), CAIQ-export.json (export stub).

Next steps:
1) Emma — confirm the owners and whether the 5-week cadence works.
2) Ben — can your infra team confirm test account provisioning by Friday?
3) Neha/Jordan — I will need a rapid artifacts intake slot; propose Tue 9/7 at 11am PT.

Thanks — happy to tighten any items.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com (415) 555-0123
[attachment: Acme_MAP_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet); attachment: SOC2-evidence-request.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-09-06T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: MAP kickoff — security gate expectations and timeline

Team — forwarding Acme's asks and the draft MAP. Short asks for you both: can Neha own the SOC 2 evidence intake and map the artifacts to controls? Jordan — can you own PoC provisioning + SIG/CAIQ remediation plan for medium items?

Proposed micro-tasks:
- Neha: prepare evidence intake checklist and a 30-min walkthrough slot on Tue 9/7 11am PT. Add any items that will require engineering support.
- Jordan: confirm whether our sandbox can generate the sample traffic and whether we need to stub sensitive fields for Acme; supply an access checklist by EOD Fri 9/3.

If you need, I can pull in a second SE for the CAIQ deep-dive. Also note: Acme requested a shortened retention window for EU data — that requires a quick legal addendum; I'll coordinate with Legal after we confirm technical feasibility.

Thanks — Kim

From: Ben Torres <ben.torres@acme-payments.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Emma Liu <emma.liu@acme-payments.com>
Date: 2027-09-09T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff — security gate expectations and timeline

Kimberly and team — thanks for the fast turnaround and the MAP doc. Quick confirmations from Acme:

- Timeline: 5-week plan looks good; we can compress Week 2 and Week 3 into a single week if evidence intake shows no major gaps.
- SOC 2: please upload the Type II and evidence map to the shared drive by Monday 9/13; we'll schedule the walkthrough the same week.
- SIG/CAIQ: medium items that are configuration-only are acceptable as a POA (plan of action), but anything requiring code changes must be flagged.
- DPA: attached is a short redline summary from our counsel (see DPA-redline-vS1.docx). We prefer the EU logs retention at 30 days as you suggested.

Next steps: 1) Please post SOC2 artifacts to the Drive and comment in the HubSpot MAP card; 2) We'll review the CAIQ and mark any blockers by 9/14; 3) I will upload the DPA redline (attached).

Ben Torres
Sr. Manager, Infrastructure Security
Acme Payments
